title: IP and Mobile Network Security and Hardening Specialist
functions: Technical design in the security and hardening of critical IP and transport infrastructures for Telefónica Spain (red RIMA, red Fusión, red Anillo, and red Rumba).
Implementation of Hardening guides based on CIS Benchmarks and STIG standards for multi-vendor network equipment (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Huawei, Ericsson, and Red Hat).

Design and deployment of perimeter security controls, access policy management (ACLs, Control Plane Policing), authentication protocols (RADIUS, TACACS+, LDAP), and integration with Linux PAM modules.
Automation of compliance and hardening audits using HP Network Automation for configuration control in massive production environments.
Development of SOP (Standard Operating Procedures) technical documentation, standardization of security reports, and level 3 support in FOA (First Office Application) deployments.
